qwen-1.7b.characterization: fast transcript, no native timing or speakers; the interview default

processing.note: 180-second chunks, one at a time. Requesting diarization replaces them with the diarizer's turns, and that count is not known until the diarizer runs.

failure_recovery.note: Units are independent, so a failure leaves the finished ones usable and --range addresses the rest. The global generation budget stops between units rather than inside one.

cost.proved: 54 s and 3.0 GiB peak to transcribe a 30-minute Cantonese interview on an M4 Max, batch 1 with the MLX cache cleared per batch and a Cantonese language hint.

execution.note: stages run strictly sequentially and no two model stages are resident together; wall time adds across stages, peak memory does not, and per-stage peaks must not be summed

languages.catalog_note: Accepts the 30 names published by both pinned Qwen config.json support_languages arrays, case-insensitively and with canonical spelling. Only Mandarin, English and Cantonese have actually been run here.
languages.plan_note: The language hint is optional and constrains the ASR decode without adding an output key.

verbatim.catalog_note: Emits disfluencies rather than cleaning them, but drops every spoken uh on the recorded probe. Filler recall remains unmeasured.
verbatim.plan_note: Emits disfluencies rather than applying a cleanup pass; fidelity is not ranked from the small recorded probe.

diarization.catalog_note: Adds FluidAudio in a Swift environment and produces speaker labels on text together with turn intervals. The shipped no-speaker-prior configuration is unmeasured.
diarization.plan_note: Anonymous labels are reconciled sample-exactly onto ASR text together with the diarizer's turn intervals.

overlapped_speech.catalog_note: Enables FluidAudio overlapping-segments mode in the same stage as diarization. Without this request an empty abstention ledger means undetected rather than absent.
overlapped_speech.plan_note: FluidAudio supplies cross-speaker overlap intervals and licenses overlap abstentions.

vad.catalog_note: Adds the hash-pinned Silero VAD: 0.8505 frame-level F1 at 0.7655 precision and 0.9567 recall on one 150-second fixture.
vad.plan_note: Measured as an activity gate against one union-of-speakers reference; it does not establish speaker or language quality.

word_timestamps.catalog_note: Adds Qwen3-ForcedAligner in the MLX environment. Boundary error against hand-labelled timing is unmeasured and a non-speech segment may have no word stream.
word_timestamps.plan_note: Boundary error against labels is unmeasured, and words remain absent on a segment with no speech to align.

segment_timestamps.catalog_note: This stack emits no segment extents. Its chunk boundaries are processing containers, not speech timing, and are never published as segment bounds.

lid.catalog_note: This stack exposes no region language labels. The capability is available on firered through its dedicated LID stage.

token_lid.refusal_fix: no stack or add-on satisfies this; code-switching support does not imply per-token language labels, and the nearest available output is lid, which labels a whole speech region
token_lid.catalog_note: Named only so a request fails loudly. Code-switching support does not imply per-token labels, and no backend here produces them.

vibevoice.roles: asr with native speaker structure and segment bounds
vibevoice.characterization: native speakers and segment bounds, highest memory, prefix-only recovery after generation truncation

processing.note: The whole input is handed to one generate call. Complete decoded segments can be salvaged from a generation truncation, but there are no independent units.

failure_recovery.note: Generation truncation can preserve complete decoded segments before the cut and --range addresses the remainder; a failure before the first complete segment leaves nothing. On spice-30min-participant, 11,345 generated tokens over 1,800 seconds is 6.30 tokens/second; at that observed rate, the declared 16,384-token cap projects to about 43 minutes of comparable audio. This is a rate extrapolation, not an observed truncation.

cost.proved: About 14 min and 20.28 GiB live MPS allocation for a 30-minute sample on an M4 Max, seeded bfloat16 decode.

execution.note: VibeVoice runs in torch-vibevoice and any aligner runs later in mlx; the environment processes are not resident together, so stage walls add and peaks do not

warnings.detail: measured 20.28 GiB live MPS allocation on spice-30min-participant; a strict 16 GiB MPS cap OOMs at model load, measured on a 27.8 s probe, while an 18 GiB cap passed that probe

languages.catalog_note: Advertises multilingual and code-switching transcription, but accepts no language hint. Mandarin, English and Cantonese are the locally exercised set.
languages.plan_note: Language handling is native and takes no caller hint on this stack.

verbatim.catalog_note: Emits disfluencies rather than cleaning them, but two recorded dialect forms were normalized relative to FireRed's output.

diarization.catalog_note: Produces native anonymous speaker labels and segment bounds. It matched 39 of 75 annotated speaker changes on the dense recorded conversation.
diarization.plan_note: Each bounded speech segment forms its own native turn, so no gap or non-speech event is filled.

overlapped_speech.catalog_note: Adds FluidAudio overlapping-segments mode. Without this request nothing in the plan detects cross-speaker overlap.

segment_timestamps.catalog_note: Native segment extents are emitted with VibeVoice's structured transcript and have not been scored against hand labels.

lid.catalog_note: This stack exposes no region language-label output. Firered is the stack that supplies the capability.

firered.roles: vad, asr and punctuator always; lid as well when lid is requested
firered.characterization: native word timing, speech regions and region language; no speakers

processing.note: FireRedVAD segments the audio and every later stage runs per region, four at a time. The count depends on speech activity and is not known until VAD runs.

failure_recovery.note: Regions are independent, so a failure leaves the finished ones usable and --range addresses the rest.

cost.proved: 11 min 5 s and 9.1 GiB peak to transcribe a 30-minute sample on an M4 Max, CPU float32 with LID off and batch size 4. Peak is dominated by model weights.

execution.note: FireRed runs one process with VAD, ASR and punctuator co-resident; requesting lid loads that model into the same process. The measured LID-off peak is 9830449152 bytes (9.16 GiB), not a maximum of imaginary per-role processes.
execution.lid_note: FireRed runs one process that loads VAD, LID, ASR and punctuator together. On the same 139.284-second probe, LID on measured 162.09 s and 13169377280 bytes (12.26 GiB) peak RSS; LID off measured 84.24 s and 9830449152 bytes (9.16 GiB).

languages.catalog_note: Advertises Mandarin, English, code-switching and Chinese dialects; only Mandarin, English and Cantonese have run here. It takes no language hint.
languages.plan_note: Language handling is native and takes no caller hint on this stack.

verbatim.catalog_note: Emits disfluencies rather than cleaning them and retained both recorded dialect forms. Two lexemes cannot rank varieties.
verbatim.plan_note: Emits disfluencies and retained the dialect form on both recorded probes; broader fidelity is unmeasured.

diarization.catalog_note: Adds FluidAudio in a Swift environment, producing text speaker labels and turn intervals together. The shipped no-prior configuration is unmeasured.
diarization.plan_note: Anonymous labels are reconciled sample-exactly onto ASR text together with the diarizer's turn intervals.

overlapped_speech.catalog_note: Enables FluidAudio overlapping-segments mode in the same stage as diarization. Without it an empty abstention ledger means undetected rather than absent.
overlapped_speech.plan_note: FluidAudio supplies cross-speaker overlap intervals and licenses overlap abstentions.

vad.catalog_note: FireRedVAD supplies regions natively but has no measured accuracy. The Silero pin substitutes a separately measured activity gate.
vad.plan_note: No measured accuracy for this stage; --vad silero-vad substitutes a path that has a measured 0.8505 frame-level F1.

word_timestamps.catalog_note: Native word intervals were monotonic across recorded long runs but were never scored against hand-labelled boundaries.
word_timestamps.plan_note: Monotonic on recorded runs, with boundary accuracy against labels unmeasured.

segment_timestamps.catalog_note: Sentence extents come from the punctuation stage and remain unmeasured against labelled boundaries.

lid.plan_note: One of the pinned FireRedLID labels is emitted per VAD region; per-sentence variation would be fabricated.
